items.name: keyboard
items.title: Keyboard UI
items.description: An interactive keyboard that lights up as you type and can type out your text on a loop. A hero visual for developer tools.

items.name: scroll-tracker
items.title: Scroll Tracker
items.description: A reading-progress bar that tracks scroll position across the page or inside any scroll container.

items.name: pro-button
items.title: Pro Button
items.description: A call-to-action button with an animated pixel arrow, in three sizes and several colours.

items.name: typewriter-loop
items.title: Typewriter Loop
items.description: A headline that cycles through words with a typewriter wipe, a coloured cursor and optional gradient text.

items.name: cyberpunk-button
items.title: Cyberpunk Button
items.description: A futuristic button whose pixel panel sweeps across it on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: flip-clock
items.title: Flip Clock
items.description: A split-flap clock and countdown timer with smooth flip animations, in four sizes and several variants.

items.name: encoded-reveal
items.title: Encoded Reveal
items.description: Text that decrypts into place: random characters scramble, then resolve letter by letter.

items.name: slide-up-reveal
items.title: Slide Up Reveal
items.description: A text reveal that slides characters, words or lines up into view, with stagger and scroll triggers.

items.name: blur-reveal
items.title: Blur Reveal
items.description: Text that comes into focus from a blur, letter by letter, on mount or when scrolled into view.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A light sweep that glides across text, for loading states and premium labels.

items.name: kinetic-grid
items.title: Kinetic Grid
items.description: An interactive grid background whose lines and nodes ripple outward wherever you click.

items.name: repelling-grid
items.title: Repelling Grid
items.description: An interactive dot-grid background whose dots move away from the cursor.

items.name: fluid-shader
items.title: Fluid Shader
items.description: A flowing, glossy WebGL fluid background with configurable colours, speed and complexity.

items.name: sphere-shader
items.title: Sphere Shader
items.description: A glowing 3D sphere rendered with Three.js and a bloom pass, for hero sections.

items.name: cueit
items.title: Cueit design system
items.description: An Apple-inspired design system: a scoped stylesheet that re-skins the shadcn/ui foundation, plus a KPI tile, a segmented control and a page header.

items.name: skita
items.title: Skita design system
items.description: A dense, monospaced workspace system: a scoped stylesheet that re-skins the shadcn/ui foundation in Geist Mono, zinc and one green, plus a KPI tile, an inset grouped list, a cascade loader and a page header.

items.name: beacon-badge
items.title: Beacon Badge
items.description: A status badge with a pulsing beacon dot and a blur-in label, for live, new and alert states.

items.name: folio
items.title: Folio design system
items.description: An editorial design system: a scoped stylesheet that re-skins the shadcn/ui foundation in paper, ink and one vermilion, plus a masthead and a report-style figure.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: An overview screen in an app shell: four KPIs with one emphasised, recent invoices with status tints, and plan usage. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.

items.name: data-table-01
items.title: Data table
items.description: A customers table with status filter tabs, search, row selection with select-all and paging. Works on any rows you pass. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Settings
items.description: An account settings page: a section list beside profile, notification switches, density radio cards and a danger zone. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.

items.name: form-01
items.title: Create form
items.description: A new-project form with a URL derived from the name, visibility as radio cards, and validation that replaces a hint with its error. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.

items.name: auth-01
items.title: Sign in
items.description: A split sign-in page: email, password and Google on one side, a customer quote on the emphasised surface on the other. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Three plans with a monthly and yearly switch. The recommended plan takes the one emphasised surface a view gets. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.

items.name: empty-state-01
items.title: Empty states
items.description: A reusable EmptyState and the three a product needs: first run, no search results and a failed load. Renders in any Satori UI design system (cueit, skita, folio or a generated one): install a system first.
